title: शिक्षार्थीको सक्षमता विकास र पृष्ठपोषणमा आन्तरिक मूल्यांकनको भूमिका{The Role of Internal Assessment in Developing and Nurturing Learner Competencies}
nepali: यस लेखमा त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षाशास्त्र, स्नातकोत्तर तहको सेमेस्टर प्रणालीको आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कनको विश्वसनीयता तथा वैधताप्रति सरोकारवालाको दृष्टिकोणलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यसमा क्षेत्रीय सर्वेक्षण विधि उपयोग गरिएको छ भने उद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट प्रक्रिया अपनाइएको छ । शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्काय स्नातकोत्तर तहमा अध्यापनरत २५ जना शिक्षक तथा उक्त तहमा अध्ययनरत १०० जना विद्यार्थीलाई नमुनाका रूपमा लिई उनीहरूबाट प्राप्त अभिमतको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनबाट विद्यार्थीहरूमा शैक्षणिक सक्षमता विकासमा आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कनको उच्च महत्वो रहेको निचोड प्राप्त भएको छ । उक्त कथनमा शिक्षकको ८४ प्रतिशत र शिक्षार्थीको ८३ प्रतिशत सकारात्मक मत प्राप्त भएको छ । यसले शैक्षणिक सक्षमता विकास गर्नमा आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कनको भूमिकाप्रति शिक्षक एवम् शिक्षार्थी विश्वस्त भएको प्रमाणित गर्दछ । त्यस्तै, आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कन प्रक्रियाबाट शिक्षण सिकाइ प्रक्रियामा पनि पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त भएको जनाइएको भए पनि पूर्ण सन्तुष्ट हुन नसकिने अभिमत प्राप्त भएको छ किनभने यस कथनमा ७७ प्रतिशत शिक्षार्थी सकारात्मक देखिनु अपेक्षाकृत भए पनि शिक्षक जम्मा ६० प्रतिशत मात्र सकारात्मक देखिएका छन्। आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कनले शिक्षार्थीमा पर्याप्त पृष्ठपोषणसहित प्राप्त भएको सवालमा शिक्षकका तुलनामा १७ प्रतिशत शिक्षार्थी बढी सकारात्मक रहेको निष्कर्ष प्राप्त भएको छ । यसरी आन्तरिक मूल्याङ्कनले शैक्षणिक सक्षमता विकासका तुलनामा पर्याप्त पृष्ठपोषण प्रदान गर्न नसकेको नतिजा प्राप्त भएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, stakeholders' perspectives regarding the reliability and validity of internal assessment in Tribhuvan University's Master's level semester system in education are presented. In this study, a field survey method was used, while a purposive sampling procedure was adopted. Taking as a sample 25 teachers teaching at the Master's level in the Faculty of Education and 100 students studying at that level, the opinions obtained from them were analyzed. From this study, the conclusion was obtained that internal assessment holds high importance in developing pedagogical competency among students. On that statement, an 84 percent positive opinion was obtained from teachers and an 83 percent positive opinion from learners. This proves that both teachers and learners are convinced of the role of internal assessment in developing pedagogical competency. Likewise, although it was indicated that feedback is also obtained in the teaching-learning process from the internal assessment procedure, the opinion was obtained that one cannot be fully satisfied, because on this statement, while 77 percent of learners appeared positive as expected, only 60 percent of teachers appeared positive. On the question of whether internal assessment is received by learners with adequate feedback, the finding was obtained that learners were 17 percent more positive compared to teachers. Thus, the result was obtained that internal assessment has failed to provide adequate feedback in comparison to the development of pedagogical competency.

informal_english: In this paper, stakeholders' perspectives regarding the reliability and validity of internal assessment in Tribhuvan University's Master's level semester system in education are presented. A field survey method was used here, while a purposive sampling procedure was adopted to pick the participants. Taking 25 teachers teaching at the Master's level in the Faculty of Education and 100 students studying at that level as a sample, the opinions obtained from them were analysed. From this study, the conclusion was obtained that internal assessment holds massive importance in developing pedagogical competency among students. On that statement, an 84 per cent positive opinion came from teachers and an 83 per cent positive opinion from learners. This proves that both teachers and learners are thoroughly convinced of the role of internal assessment in developing pedagogical competency. Mind you, although folk noted that feedback is also obtained in the teaching-learning process from the internal assessment procedure, they weren't entirely chuffed, because on this statement, while 77 per cent of learners were positive as expected, only 60 per cent of teachers appeared positive. On the question of whether internal assessment is received by learners with adequate feedback, the finding was that learners were 17 per cent more positive compared to teachers. So at the end of the day, the result is that internal assessment has failed to provide adequate feedback in comparison to the development of pedagogical competency.
